tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'on rgod du song ba'i sku rnams kyi 'dod gsol bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ phyogs dus rgyal ba kun gyi gang 'dul rol dbyings las snyigs dus bstan 'gro'i mgon gcig rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin yongs kyi 'byung gnas 'phags mchog pad dkar 'dzin pa dge bsnyen mchog gi rnam rol dpal sa skya pa chen po brtse chen kun dga' snying po nyid slar yang rang rigs su ngur smrig gi bla gos 'chang ba'i tshul gyis rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs dang / khyad par rang lugs snyan brgyud pa bstan pa rin po che'i mnga' bdag mkhas shing grub brnyes 'gran zla dang bral ba bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs la rigs dbon gyi tha shal ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rigs kyi gdung yum sogs ltos bcas thams cad phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshe rabs thams cad rjes su gzung du gsol/ rnam 'dren dam pa gang gi sku dang dam pa nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i brgyud 'dzin bstan pa rin po che spyi sgos la bka' drin che ba rje btsun rdo rings pa chen po kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma blo ldan shes rab kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rmor chen rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ bdag gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa dpal gnas gsar ba chen po 'jam mgon bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po sku drin mtshungs pa med pa'i zhal snga nas rnams kyi sku brnyan ring bsrel rnam bzhis phyur bur gtams shing / rab gnas byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba/ grub dbang rgod phrug grags pa 'byung gnas dang / rmor chen rdo rje 'chang gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas su mchod tshogs dang bcas bzhugs su gsol ba'i byin rlabs kyis bstan pa rin po che spyi bye dar rgyas 'byung ba dang /

'gro kun 'phral yun bde skyid kyis 'tsho zhing / khyad par bdag la ltos bcas dus gsum thams cad la gnas skabs mthar thug gi re smon ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ mdor na sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa legs tshogs ji snyed kun/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pas/ /myur du 'grub par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol// ༈ /gdung chos su mgon skur 'dod gsol// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bka' dang bdag cag rnams kyis gsol ba btab pa la brten nas/ rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po yum chen ral gcig lha mo 'dod khams dbang phyug nag po gnod sbyin/ nag mo gnod sbyin/ pu tra bha ṭa/ sring mo dregs pa rgyud gsum/ rten 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas gdung phud chos 'khor 'dir rgyal bstan dri med rje btsun sa skya pa'i mdo sngags bstan 'dzin dge 'dun sde bcas 'phel zhing rgyas nas bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub phyir yul phyogs 'di'i lha sde mi sde kun gyi 'gal rkyen sel zhing / mthun rkyen spel ba dang / khyad par chu'i gnod pa dgra 'dre byur sogs mi mthun pa'i rigs kun zhi zhing / zhi bas mi dul ba rnams lo zla ma 'gyangs par tshar bcad nas sa phyogs 'dir rje btsun sa skya pa'i bka' srol chos srid dpal 'byor dar brtan dang mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub kun myur du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod cig/ ༈ /dpal rab rnga chung dang ḍā rur bzo gnang skabs 'dod gsol// rtsa gsum mchog gsum kun rnga 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas log 'dren skrod pa dang / dge legs snyan grags kyis srid zhi'i dngos grub ma lus pa bstsal du gsol/ ḍā rur/ gsung dbyangs mi 'jigs seng ge'i sgra/ /yan lag drug cu dang ldan pa/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten thams cad la/ /legs sgrags don gnyis lhun grub shog/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT
